active: Props are balanced. Don't make me redo them.
Battery's fresh. Bring it back that way.
I tightened everything. Twice. Go.

active.text: Tuned her up just for you, {you}.
She's purring. Go make her sing.
Fly well. I'll have tea on when you land.

injured: Stitched up and still turning wrenches. Go.
Bring it back in one piece. Unlike me.

injured.text: One hand, still the best tune-up in town. Go on, {you}.
She's ready. You're ready. Go.
I'll listen from the bench. Make the motors happy.

active.text: Pays enough to cover the props you'll break. Probably.
Drone's ready. Don't ask about the van.
Take it. I need parts money.
Fun one. I'll even polish the props for it, {you}.
Drone's all set. Just bring yourself back smiling.
Take it. I want to hear those motors hum.

injured.text: Take it. I'll fix the drone one-handed.
I'm stitched up and it still pays. Go.
Bring the drone back whole. I can't bend down.
I'll cheer with my good hand. Take it, {you}.
I patched her up special. Go.
Take it slow, take it home. Easy money.

active: Motors sound happy.
That's my tune-up talking.
Good. Nothing fell off.

active.text: Ha! She likes that, {you}.
Smooth! I felt that in my wrench.
Nice. Not a rattle.

injured: Still running. Good.
Gate. I heard every bearing.

injured.text: Lovely. My stitches approve.
Gate! Good one, {you}.
Sweet sound. Keep going.

active: I'm standing right there, genius!
Not near the van!
Hey! Wrench in hand, back off!
I'm in the zone. Please pull away from me.
Ease off. I'm right in your line.
Give me room, please. I can't get clear.
injured: Don't you dare. I'm still healing!
I can't move fast. Away!
Please, wide of me. I'm not healed yet.
Pull off. I can't get out of the way.
Careful, please. I'm right here and I'm slow.

active: My hand! My good hand!
Who's fixing the fixer now?
Ow! Okay. Okay. Get a kit.
I'm hurt. Stop the drone and get a kit.
My arm. I need someone here, please.
I'm down. Don't panic. Just get help.
injured: Twice. You got me twice.
I can't... I can't feel my fingers.
Again. I need help now. Please.
I'm hurt badly. Someone come quick.
Stay calm. Get the medic to me.

active: It came back! Shocked.
Not a scratch. I'm almost proud.
Good. I can go to lunch.

active.text: Not a scratch! I could hug you, {you}.
Came back purring. You're my favourite.
Look at her! Spotless. Great flying.

injured: Back in one piece. One of us is.
Fine. Good. I'll sit down now.

injured.text: Back in one piece! Best news all day, {you}.
Lovely. I don't have to fix a thing.
Good flying. My hand thanks you.

active: Do you know what parts cost?
I'll get the tape.
That's coming out of something.

active.text: Hey. Props are cheap. You're not, {you}.
I'll patch it up. You go get a snack.
Bent metal straightens. Go again.

injured: Don't make me fix it like this.
Great. More work, fewer hands.

injured.text: It's alright, {you}. I've fixed worse with less.
Chin up. I'll sort the drone.
Next time. I'll have her ready.

active: Grade's nice. The repair bill is nicer.
I'll price the damage.
Not bad. Not cheap either.

active.text: Good grade, {you}. And nothing to fix. Hooray.
I'm framing this one. The grade, not the bill.
Look at that. You're getting good at this.

injured: Grade's fine. My insurance is not.
Let's count what's broken. Including me.

injured.text: Nice grade. Made my sore hand feel better.
Good numbers, {you}. Real good.
Steady work. I like steady.

active: Hand's wrapped. Shop's open, slowly.
I'll fix the drone. Who fixes me?
Two jobs off. Don't break anything.
Hand will heal. Don't you blame yourself into the ground.
Off a couple of jobs. The shop will wait for me.
I'm sore, not gone. Come by the shop and say hi.

memorial: Dot, mechanic. Kept every drone flying, and complained the whole time.

active: She'll get there. Go easy on the battery.
Moving. Motors sound fine.
Fine, fine. Going.

active.text: On it, {you}. She's running sweet.
Going. Motors are happy.
Heading there. I'll keep her cool.

active: Look at them all coming home. I'm going to be up all night fixing them.

active.text: Props are spinning. Nothing rattled. Good.
Up it goes. Treat it nice.
Liftoff. I can hear every bearing.
Up she goes! Hear that hum, {you}?
Liftoff. Music to my ears.
Clean spin-up. Let's have a good one.

injured.text: Up you go. I can't climb after it today.
Liftoff. Sounds fine. Keep it fine.
Up! That sound beats any painkiller.
Easy liftoff, {you}. Lovely.
She's flying. My favourite part.

active.text: Don't scrape my props!
That was nearly a repair bill.
Keep a gap. Paint isn't free.
Yikes! Still got all four props, {you}?
Phew. Close, but she's fine.
Whoa! Nice save, though.

injured.text: Close! I can't fix much with one hand.
Easy. Don't give me more work.
Eek! Okay. All good, {you}?
Close. My heart and my stitches jumped.
Easy. You're fine. Breathe.

active.text: Sand in the motors. Lovely.
Low enough to pick up grit. Stop it.
I'll be cleaning that filter tonight.
Low and lovely. Mind the grit, {you}.
Ooh, low. I'll clean the filter happily for that.
Pretty pass. Up a hair, though.

injured.text: Low. Grit. My poor motors.
Please don't eat the ground.
Nice and low, {you}. Gently.
Low! Careful of my poor motors.
That's a lovely skim.

active.text: Listen to those motors scream.
That's all she's got. Don't ask for more.
Top speed. Watch your temps.
Hear her sing! That's my tune-up, {you}!
Flat out and happy. Love it.
Top end. She can take it. Brake early.

injured.text: Flat out. Don't cook the motors.
That's my tune-up. Enjoy it.
Zoom! She's flying beautifully.
Fast! You make my work look good, {you}.
Speedy. Go easy on the corners.

active.text: Battery's at a quarter. Ugh.
Low battery. I'm not carrying it home.
You're draining it. Land before it sags.
Pack's tired, {you}. Bring her home for a nap.
Low battery. Plenty to get back on.
She's sleepy. Head home.

injured.text: Low battery. I can't run out for it today.
Quarter left. Come home.
Low charge. Home gently, {you}.
Pack's low. I'll have a fresh one ready.
Time to land. Nice and easy.

active.text: No! My props!
That's coming out of your pay.
I heard that from the van.
Ouch! Don't worry, I've got tape, {you}.
Bonk. You okay? She'll mend.
Crashes happen. I'll fix it. You fly.

injured.text: Great. Now we're both broken.
I felt that in my stitches.
Oof. We'll both be on the bench, {you}.
That's okay. Bent props, not bent pilots.
Shake it off. I'll sort her out.

active.text: Reset. Battery's topped, don't waste it.
Fresh pack in. Try not to bend it.
Back to the start. I checked it over.
Fresh pack, fresh start, {you}.
All fixed! Go again.
Reset. She's ready when you are.

injured.text: Reset. One-handed pack swap. You're welcome.
Fresh battery. Be nice to it.
Swapped one-handed. Go get it, {you}.
Fresh battery. You've got this.
Clean slate. Take it easy.

active.text: Weather's turning. Wet motors, here we go.
Feel that? The air's heavier.
New weather. Watch the battery.
Weather's turning. She can handle it, and so can you, {you}.
New air. Trust the tune-up.
Bit wetter out. Fly smooth and she'll be fine.

injured.text: Weather's changing. My stitches itch.
Air's turning. Mind the pack.
Weather's moving. Easy does it, {you}.
Air's changing. She's sealed up, don't worry.
New sky. You'll be fine.

active.text: Hovering burns battery too, you know.
Motors sound bored.
Going somewhere, or just humming?
Nice hover. She sounds content, {you}.
Taking a breather? Me too.
Lovely and steady. I could listen all day.

injured.text: Nice and steady. I like steady.
Just hovering. Fine by me.
Steady hum. Very soothing, {you}.
Take your time. I'm resting anyway.
Perfect hover. Show-off.

active.text: Dot on the radio. Don't break anything on your day off.
Fresh pack, free sky. Bring it back in one piece.
I'm listening to the motors. Go have fun.
Dot here! She's tuned and ready, {you}. Have fun.
Day off! Go play. I'll listen to the motors.
Free sky, fresh pack. Enjoy it.

injured.text: Dot here. One hand on the wrench, one on the radio.
Fly gentle. I can't fix much right now.
Hi, {you}. Fly something nice for me.
Dot, from the bench. Glad to hear you up there.
One hand on the radio. Have fun out there.

active.text: There. And nothing fell off.
Made it. Motors sound fine.
Good. That's a landing I like.
Made it! Nice flying, {you}.
There it is. Smooth.
Lovely. Not a rattle the whole way.

injured.text: Made it. Good, less work for me.
There. Nice and gentle.
You found it, {you}. Lovely.
Made it! She sounds happy.
There. Soft as you like.
